thread:
kyra: Hi — trying to pay invoice INV-2026-045 with our corp card (Visa ****4242) but getting 'card_declined' and '05 Do not honor'. Any idea?

maria-support: Sorry about that. Can you share transaction id, timestamp, and PO#?

kyra: tx_id=tx_abc123456789, attempted at 2026-03-16T14:18:02Z, amount $12,500 USD, PO# PO-7788, VAT ID GB999999973

billing-bot: Payment attempt logged: tx_abc123456789 status=declined code=05 reason="Do not honor" processor=stripe-connector mcc=5734 country=GB

maria-support: Thanks. Decline code 05 is generic. I see MCC 5734 (computer stores) and country=GB — this could be corporate spend-controls (MCC whitelist) or per-transaction cap.

jake-finance: Kyra — our corp cards have a merchant-category whitelist and a per-transaction cap of $5,000. This charge is $12.5k so it's getting blocked by spend limits. Also we block some overseas MCCs unless preapproved.

kyra: Oh, got it. The vendor is a UK hosting partner, invoice was expected. How can we get this paid today? It's due.

anshul-eng: From payments platform logs the authorization never got an approval back from processor. No API errors on our side beyond the decline. Workarounds: manual wire / SEPA, split the charge into multiple cards/payments, or request a temporary limit bump.

maria-support: Options: 1) Finance can do a one-time per-transaction limit increase for PO-7788. 2) Request whitelist of MCC 5734 for this vendor. 3) Accept wire transfer (we can generate bank details). Which do you prefer?

jake-finance: I can approve a one-time emergency bump. Need account id and written approval in thread. Also who signs the PO?

kyra: Account is ac_91234. I can confirm the PO and vendor details. We need the bump so the card can be charged.

maria-support: Escalating to ops team. @ops-oncall please assist with increasing per-tx cap to cover $12.5k for ac_91234 and note a follow-up to review MCC whitelist.

ops-oncall: On it. Please provide explicit finance approval (reply with 'approve') so I can audit-change controls.

jake-finance: approve

ops-oncall: Done — increased per-transaction limit to $20,000 for account ac_91234 until 2026-03-18T00:00:00Z. Audit id: audit_20260316_001. Please re-attempt payment.

kyra: Retried payment at 2026-03-16T14:47:10Z — success! tx_id=tx_abc123456789_retry status=paid processor=worldpay amount=12500 USD :tada:

billing-bot: Payment succeeded. invoice=INV-2026-045 status=paid method=card last4=4242 processor=worldpay

maria-support: Closing loop. Root cause: corporate spend-control per-transaction cap + MCC whitelist not set for this vendor. Action items: [1] Jake to review permanent policy and approve vendor whitelist if recurring. [2] Add KB entry for emergency limit bumps and MCC whitelist process. [3] Consider split-payment UI note for invoices > cap.

jake-finance: I'll follow up and confirm vendor whitelist by EOD.

kyra: Thanks everyone :pray:

maria-support: Marking thread resolved.
